{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = data.isnull().sum()

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_values = data[data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999]

# Check unique sites
unique_sites = data['site'].unique()

# Check response rate per site
response_rate = data.groupby('site')['responded'].mean()

missing_values, sentinel_values.shape[0], unique_sites, response_rate"}
